description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance for various fine-tuning methods applied to RoBERTa models of two sizes: 'base' (represented by blue bars) and 'large' (represented by orange bars). The horizontal axis, labeled 'Fine-tuning Method', lists the methods in the order: an unlabeled gray bar, 'Adaptor', 'LoRA', 'BitFit', 'S₁-model', 'S₄-model', and 'S₅-model'. The vertical axis, labeled 'GLUE Performance', is scaled linearly from approximately 85 to 89, with major tick marks at 86 and 88, indicating performance is measured in percentage points. For each fine-tuning method, two bars are shown side-by-side, representing the performance of the base and large RoBERTa models. The 'Adaptor' method shows a performance of approximately 87.5 for the large model and around 85.5 for the base model. The 'LoRA' method achieves the highest performance, with the large model at approximately 88.5 and the base model at approximately 87.0. The 'BitFit' method shows significantly lower performance for the base model, around 85.0, while the large model achieves approximately 87.5. The 'S₁-model' and 'S₄-model' show comparable performance for both model sizes, with the large model at approximately 86.5 and the base model at approximately 85.5 for S₁-model, and the large model at approximately 87.5 and the base model at approximately 86.5 for S₄-model. The 'S₅-model' shows the highest performance for the base model, around 87.5, and the largest model achieves approximately 89.0. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
